summary: Council gave first, second and third readings to the Fire Prevention and Regulation Bylaw No. 1665 and its amending Bylaw No. 2286. Council adopted multiple zoning, park and reserve fund bylaws including Bylaw 2110 (854 Latoria Road), Bylaw 2278 (Jacklin Road), Bylaw 2288 (Park Dedication) and Bylaw 2294 (Reserve Funds Establishment). Council issued Temporary Use Permits for 4373 West Shore Parkway (TUP26-0005) and 890 Goldstream Avenue (TUP26-0006) and directed staff to provide notice to consider a TUP for Unit 107-2317 Millstream Road. Council rescinded and re-gave third reading to the Parks Development Cost Charge Bylaw No. 2291 and gave first reading to OCP amendment Bylaw No. 2292. Council approved a notice-of-motion directing staff to write to the Minister to request reinstatement of ARC Foundation funding.

items.plain_english_summary: Council issued Temporary Use Permit TUP26-0005 to permit receiving, preparing and storage of recreational vehicles for sale at 4373 West Shore Parkway subject to specified conditions.

motions.motion_text: THAT Temporary Use Permit No. TUP26-0005 be issued by the Council for the City of Langford to Mark Jones of Galaxy Motors (0698721 BC Ltd.) to allow the land to be used for receiving, preparing and storage of recreational vehicles for sale at the applicant’s RV Dealership on the adjacent lot (4377 West Shore Parkway) without building a structure that meets the 10% minimum lot coverage, subject to the following terms and conditions: (a) No razor wire fencing; (b) At least 10lb dry chemical fire extinguisher must be available on site at all times; (c) Address for the site to be posted as per City of Langford bylaw; and (d) Maintain an access lane on site for fire suppression for the duration.
motions.plain_english_summary: Council issued TUP26-0005 for 4373 West Shore Parkway with conditions.
motions.outcome_source_quote: THAT Temporary Use Permit No. TUP26-0005 be issued by the Council for the City of Langford to Mark Jones of Galaxy Motors (0698721 BC Ltd.) to allow the land to be used for receiving, preparing and storage of recreational vehicles for sale at the applicant’s RV Dealership on the adjacent lot (4377 West Shore Parkway) without building a structure that meets the 10% minimum lot coverage, subject to the following terms and conditions: 1. Conditions The following requirements are imposed pursuant to section 493 of the Local Government Act: a) No razor wire fencing; b) At least 10lb dry chemical fire extinguisher must be available on site at all times; c) Address for the site to be posted as per City of Langford bylaw; and d) Maintain an access lane on site for fire suppression for the duration. Motion  CARRIED.

items.title: Notice of Motion from July 20, 2026
items.matter_title: Advocacy for the BC Ministry of Education and Childcare to reinstate funding to the ARC Foundation
items.plain_english_summary: Council directed staff to write a letter to the Minister of Education and Childcare and the MLA asking that funding to the ARC Foundation be reinstated to support SOGI 123 resources.

motions.motion_text: THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that the City of Langford Mayor and Council to direct staff to write a letter to the Minister of Education and Childcare and MLA Ravi Parmar, asking that the ministry reinstate funding to the ARC Foundation and affirm the importance of the SOGI 123 program so that school districts will continue to work with the ARC Foundation to access resources to create a safe and inclusive environment for all students.
motions.plain_english_summary: Council directed staff to write a letter urging reinstatement of ARC Foundation funding.
motions.outcome_source_quote: THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that the City of Langford Mayor and Council to direct staff to write a letter to the Minister of Education and Childcare and MLA Ravi Parmar, asking that the ministry reinstate funding to the ARC Foundation and affirm the importance of the SOGI 123 program so that school districts will continue to work with the ARC Foundation to access resources to create a safe and inclusive environment for all students, regardless of their sexual orientation or gender identity, or the diversity in their own families. Motion  CARRIED.
